summary.text: Doc Kumar, listed by the legislature as Sabi “Doc” Kumar, is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 66 in Robertson County, who took office in November 2014 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Kumar completed a surgical residency at Mount Sinai Medical Center in Miami from 1971 to 1976 and a fellowship in transplantation at the University of Miami School of Medicine in 1977.

He is a retired surgeon who founded Nashville Surgical Instruments and Springfield Surgery PC, served as an assistant clinical professor of surgery at Vanderbilt University School of Medicine, and holds four U.S. patents for surgical devices.
He is a past chief of staff of NorthCrest Medical Center in Springfield.
Kumar has been a member of the House since the 109th General Assembly and chairs the Insurance Committee.
The House website also lists him on the Calendar & Rules, Government Operations and Health committees.
Ballotpedia, which lists him as Sabi Kumar, reports that he faces Democrat Tamara Bavendam in the general election.
